description: Ranked scuba-diving forecast windows near a place for a specific day. Answers "where can I dive near {place} on {day}?" with favorable and moderate windows (wave height, wind, timing) plus site links. Values are metric with unit-suffixed fields (max_depth_m, wave_m, distance_km; wind_kn is knots — the marine convention everywhere). When presenting to a user who uses US customary units, convert depths and waves to feet and distances to miles. computed_at is when the forecast behind the answer was generated (the oldest site in the answer) — quote the citation field verbatim (it carries that time); if stale is true, say the forecast has not been updated since then. Forecast planning context only — never a safety clearance.

day.description: today | tomorrow | mon | tue | wed | thu | fri | sat | sun | YYYY-MM-DD. Default sat.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lng instead of near).

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (use with lat instead of near).

near.description: Town, city, zip, or place name, e.g. "Miami" or "Gloucester, MA". Provide this OR lat+lng.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km (10–500, default 150; auto-widens once if empty).

name: find_dive_windows
title: Find dive windows near a place
